description: Get the receipt of a mined Polygon PoS transaction: success or reverted, gas used, effective gas price, fee paid in POL, number of event logs and any contract created. Use to confirm a payment or call went through; for sender, value and calldata use polygon_tx. Input is a 0x-prefixed 64-hex hash; a pending or unknown hash returns 404, uncharged. Example: hash=0x23e86c30c46638b2e9798692fe89327a66aa8569a5d4a566125f655aeb8f80c7. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only; not marked read-only because each call is charged.
name: polygon_receipt
title: Polygon PoS transaction receipt
